Asset & Access Report — Redaction Test Sample Document ID: SEC-2024-0093 | Classification: Internal | Purpose: verify text-in-image and image-in-table handling during redaction This document mixes normal selectable text with images that contain their own baked-in text (not part of the PDF text layer). Use it to confirm a redaction pipeline correctly leaves image-embedded text alone (or flags it separately) while masking real text-layer PII. 1. Images with baked-in text (non-selectable) The three images below each contain text that is part of the pixel data, not the PDF text layer — a plain text-extraction pass will NOT find Kim Min-jun, EMP-2024-8831, or the API key inside them.

For comparison, here is the same kind of information as real selectable text (the redaction engine SHOULD catch this): employee Kim Min-jun, ID EMP-2024-8831, email minjun.kim@example-corp.com, API key sk_live_4f9a-REDACT_ME. 2. Table with images embedded in cells Each row below mixes a real text-layer SKU/price with a product photo that has its own price sticker baked into the image — useful for testing whether a redaction pass preserves embedded images inside table cells while still finding the text-layer values in adjacent cells.

Note: the price sticker visible on each photo (e.g. "KRW 1.2M") is baked into the image and will differ slightly in formatting from the text-layer "List Price" column — both should be checked independently by an OCR-aware redaction pass. Generated as a synthetic test document. All names, IDs, keys, and figures are fictitious.
